summary: Requirements re-read on the stable tree returned a single finding, the hard-overflow edge where even names and ids will not fit. The owner ruled fail closed and both spec and plan carry it.
gaps: The 'no grant hidden' promise had no behaviour for the case where even the compact name-and-id list exceeds the total prompt budget, so truncation there would violate the spec's own guarantee.
resolutions: Owner ruled fail closed: the spec and plan now state that when the compact list cannot fit, the run fails before any provider or tool call with a redacted capability_catalog_overflow startup diagnostic naming the granted and renderable counts, and acceptance criterion 4b asserts it.
open_items: Extending the catalog to the DeepAgents lane remains follow-up, with its absence asserted so the gap is explicit.
The document edit contract and decisions 0108 and 0114 remain in the superseded draft awaiting their own spec.

rounds.question: If even the bare name-and-id list of an agent's grants will not fit the prompt, what should the run do?
options: Fail the run before it starts (Recommended)
Let the prompt grow past the budget
rounds.chosen: Fail the run before it starts (Recommended)
